name: Kayano Yuuko
source: [url=/c12260]Aoi's[/url] classmate who is a member of the newspaper club, and despised in the school due to her annoying personality. She is infatuated with [url=/c12263]Ena[/url] whom she calls "onee-sama" and sees Yamato as her biggest rival.
